basic_info.description:
Flooded with natural light, this upper-floor 1-bedroom, 1-bath home is wrapped in dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows, bringing the outdoors right into your living space. Located at 2177 Third Street, you're in the heart of Dogpatch one of SF's most creative and fast-growing neighborhoods, with the waterfront just steps away. The layout feels open and intentional, with sleek Miele appliances, beautiful marble countertops, and a clean, modern design throughout. Woods Bagot, the world-renowned architecture firm behind the building, really nailed that blend of contemporary sophistication with classic San Francisco character. Life here feels like resort-style living. Start your mornings in the private gym, grab a coffee or get some work done in the resident lounge/co-working area, and end the day on the rooftop terrace looking over the Bay. Even your pets get their moment with the building's dedicated pet spa. This isn't just a place to live it's a whole lifestyle defined by comfort, design, and community, right in the middle of Dogpatch's waterfront revival.

Parking is available for an additional $350/month.
